searchText: It might be helpful to have a data transparency API on the relayer side. timestamps like when header/payload are sent back or gossiped may make "fault" more attributable. I'll review the relayer API again, it has been a minute since I looked last Heads up: we registered 10k Ropsten validators today, 1k of them are going through mev-boost, we'll increase more once it's stable. Some of the `getHeader` responses are `204`, the description for that is `No header is available.` Yes, the builder isn't producing blocks for every slot. In particular if the CL client isn't sending out slot events.
